{{Quote|That place&hellip; is strong with the dark side of the Force. A domain of evil it is. In you must go.''"<br />"''What's in there?''"<br />"''Only what you take with you.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="TESB" />}}
A '''duel''' took place in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] in the [[Cave of Evil/Legends|Dark Side Cave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], between [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]<ref name="TESB" /> and the [[Dark Spirit]], who had assumed the shape of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="POTJ" /> It was a part of Skywalker's [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] and occurred because his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] had asked him to enter the cave so he could face his darkest fears. Beforehand, when Skywalker inquired whether there was anything that posed as a threat, Yoda cryptically replied that the only thing to threaten him was "what Skywalker carried in with him," and also advised that Skywalker not bring his weaponry inside as he won't need them. Skywalker seemingly got the upper hand, [[Sai cha/Legends|beheading]] the apparition. However, when the fake Vader's [[Armor/Legends|helmeted]] head hit the ground, its mask exploded, revealing the face of Skywalker himself.<ref name="TESB" />
